decisions.reason: The request for guidance about front and back matter and other publication needs is already represented in the candidate state; the complete-cover decision does not change that guidance requirement.
The source concerns the paperback cover and publication materials, not the editorial suitability or visual consistency of chapter images.
Requiring a complete cover does not change the manuscript's editorial objective or its approved textual rewrites.
The source does not modify aspect-ratio or cropping requirements for chapter illustrations; cover and chapter-image sizing are distinguished in the local context.
The complete-cover requirement does not change whether, when, or where chapter images are placed in the book interior.
The source contains no decision about Chapter 12 heading hierarchy, punctuation, or capitalization.
The general need for back matter and author lines does not change the existing publisher-attribution content or presentation.
The source does not address the book-title newline artifact or otherwise modify title-page content or layout.
The cover and publication-material decision does not alter which client-edited manuscript revision is authoritative.
